items.name: Action
items.description: Games centered on real-time movement, timing, combat, or physical interaction.

items.name: Adventure
items.description: Games centered on exploration, discovery, quests, and progression through a world.

items.name: Platformer
items.description: Games centered on navigating spaces through running, jumping, and precise movement.

items.name: Puzzle
items.description: Games centered on logic, spatial reasoning, pattern recognition, or problem solving.

items.name: Simulation
items.description: Games centered on managing, caring for, or inhabiting a system, activity, or relationship.

items.name: Racing
items.description: Games centered on competing through courses, routes, or timed vehicle challenges.

items.name: Role-playing
items.description: Games centered on character progression, party development, and authored or systemic journeys.

items.name: Strategy
items.description: Games centered on planning, positioning, resource decisions, or long-term tactical choices.

items.name: Fighting
items.description: Games centered on direct competitive combat, spacing, timing, and character matchups.

items.name: Shooter
items.description: Games centered on aiming, projectiles, spatial awareness, and combat encounters.

items.name: Sports
items.description: Games centered on modeled sporting activities, teams, matches, or athletic competition.

items.name: Rhythm
items.description: Games centered on timing actions to music, beats, or repeating performance patterns.

items.name: Horror
items.description: Games centered on fear, tension, vulnerability, or unsettling exploration.

items.name: Stealth
items.description: Games centered on concealment, observation, evasion, and controlled infiltration.

items.name: Visual novel
items.description: Games centered on reading, branching narrative, choices, and character relationships.

items.name: Sandbox
items.description: Games centered on open-ended exploration, construction, experimentation, or player-defined goals.

items.name: Party
items.description: Games centered on social play, short competitive challenges, and shared local or online sessions.

items.name: Survival
items.description: Games centered on enduring hostile conditions through gathering, crafting, and risk management.

items.name: Educational
items.description: Games centered on learning, practice, or discovery through interactive systems.

items.name: Arcade
items.description: Games centered on immediate rules, repeatable runs, and score- or mastery-led play.
